items.title: Ernest "Kid" Milton Interview, 1961-04-26
items.q: He was doing Mr. Glenny's time, old man Glenny's time.

ctx.x: Yeah, old man. Eddie Moran, daddy. Oh yeah. Billy Moran. He was calling Billy Moran. He was an old bass player. Oh yeah. In other words, he was doing Mr. Glenny's time, old man Glenny's time. Yeah.
He was the manager of the Superior band too, I think, way back.
